# ValhallaFit

> Coaching platform for personal trainers: manage clients, build progressive workout plans, and track performance from one platform.

ValhallaFit gives personal trainers a web workspace to plan and review training, and gives their clients a mobile-friendly experience to follow workouts and log sets in the gym.

## What ValhallaFit does

- Exercise library with primary and secondary muscle group tagging (100+ exercises)
- Workout plan builder: create reusable, progressive programs with target reps, sets, and weights per exercise
- Alternative exercise support: prescribe a backup movement with its own targets
- Client management: assign plans, schedule sessions, and archive clients
- Session logging: clients log sets, reps, and weights from their phone in the gym
- Trainer review: compare actual performance against prescribed targets with delta indicators
- Weekly reusable plans: plans repeat weekly so clients can start the next session any day

## Who it is for

ValhallaFit is built for independent personal trainers who coach a handful of clients and want to stop managing workouts in spreadsheets. Clients get a simple mobile experience to follow their plan and log sessions.
